sections.title: Bot chats
highlights: Fix a timeout that prevented bots from answering in rooms, including when a new room thread first starts.
Let direct bot chats start on a shared Codex process while keeping each bot’s conversation and tools scoped to its own thread.

sections.title: Settings and navigation
highlights: Use a consistent Settings window with related pages grouped together and search across all settings.
Keep internal bot workspaces out of Projects and show J1 branding and release information under This app.
Reduce background work during sidebar scrolling and Settings navigation.
